title: Hooded Hob's Sock Gloop Stew
tagline: A midnight mutter from the hills, thickened with one very tired sock.
servings: Serves 1 hooded hob and his whole damp cellar
rhyme:
Hop to the pot, little hob in the hood,
Drop in a sock that is far from good!
Plop goes a trainer tongue, curly and grey,
Slap goes the gutter gunge, hip hip hooray!
Tip in the lawn clippings, soggy and green,
Fluff from the dryer, the fluffiest seen!
Shake in pencil shavings, a sprinkly stack,
Stir till the gloop gives a gurgle right back!
Round goes the spoon and the cellar goes pong,
Hob's midnight stew is a thick sticky song!

ingredients.item: very tired odd sock, stiff with age

steps: Hang the moonbeam over the pot, / Wait for a burble, thick and hot.
Drop in the sock with a mighty groan, / Then the trainer tongue, all on its own.
Slop in the gunge and the clippings too, / Squelch them down till they've turned to goo.
Fluff and shavings, a sprinkle, a shake, / Stir with the hood for the hob's own sake.
Ladle it out when the cellar pongs, / And serve to the hob with three wobbly gongs.
image_prompt: A chipped cauldron-shaped bowl brimming with lumpy swamp-green sludge, a curled grey trainer tongue and a limp striped odd sock draped over the rim, soggy grass clippings, drifting clouds of grey dryer fluff, pencil shavings scattered on top, a small moon-glow shimmer above the surface.
alt_text: A chipped bowl of lumpy green sludge topped with a curled trainer tongue, a limp striped sock, grass clippings, grey fluff and pencil shavings.
caption_hook:
Italy week, and the cellar hob has sent his stew recipe. It smells exactly how you'd expect.
Which ingredient would you hide from him first?
